dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Thin, pale grey edging visible along the margins of the folded flight feathers providing low-to-moderate contrast against the primary grey feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A broad, rectangular, high-contrast white patch located on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and linear boundary where the dark grey crown meets the white nape patch, followed by a sharp transition back to the grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct white subterminal spotting or barring visible on the dark rectrices.
